_comment: Tracks Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 AS AMENDED by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of 8 July 2026 (OJ L, 2026/1744, 24.7.2026, in force 27 July 2026); consolidated text 02024R1689-20260727. Supersedes eu-ai-act@2024-1689, which cited a Council press release where an enforceable text now exists, and which carried the Annex I date only in `notes` -- a field NO renderer reads, so an Annex I provider read a binding date eight months too early with their own nowhere in the pack. An Annex IV amendment or corrigendum is a NEW regimes/eu-ai-act@<version>.json, never an edit of this file (ADR-0022).
label: EU AI Act (Annex IV)
notes: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (OJ L, 12 July 2024) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of 8 July 2026 (OJ L, 2026/1744, 24.7.2026), in force 27 July 2026. Chapter III Sections 1-3 -- and ONLY those, Section 5 is not named by Art. 113(3)(c) and its fate is not established -- apply from 2 December 2027 (Annex III, Art. 6(2)) and 2 August 2028 (Annex I, Art. 6(1)). Governance (Chapter VII) has applied since 2 August 2025, NOT 2026: what moved to 2 August 2026 on the GPAI side is Art. 101 (fines on general-purpose model providers). Art. 50 transparency applies from 2 August 2026, with Art. 111(4) giving pre-2 August 2026 synthetic-content systems until 2 December 2026. New prohibited practices (Art. 5(1)(ba),(bb) and 5(1a),(1b)) apply 2 December 2026. Art. 11(1) as replaced lets SMEs and SMCs use a simplified technical documentation form the Commission must establish; no deadline is set, and notified bodies must accept it.

highRisk.scope: Chapter III, Sections 1, 2 and 3 -- Art. 113, 3rd para, point (c), as replaced by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744. Annex III systems (Art. 6(2)) from 2 December 2027; Annex I systems (Art. 6(1)) from 2 August 2028.

annexIv.supplies: **architecture, validation procedures + metrics, cybersecurity (manifest + rubric + threat model); design choices, alternatives, assumptions, pre-determined changes = the ADR journal**
annexIv.provider: third-party sourcing/licensing, sign-off on test logs

annexIv.supplies: accuracy characterization, input-data specs, oversight tooling

operatorRequired: **Point 1** general description (intended purpose, provider, versioning) · **Point 5** RMS governance & risk acceptance (art. 9).

**Point 7** harmonised-standards selection · **Point 8** the signed **EU declaration of conformity** (art. 47) · **Point 9** the **post-market monitoring plan** (art. 72(3); the Commission must adopt guidance and a template by 2 September 2027).
**Art. 12 runtime event logs** — produced by the running system, not by runward.
disclaimerTail: Annex IV wording moves — confirm against the Official Journal (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689) before filing.
